extension.summary: Silo rows as widgets for Kodi's home screen
extension.description: Shows your Silo home rows, Watchlist and Favorites as video folders that Kodi skins can use as home-screen widgets. Selecting a title plays it in Founders Theater, which must be installed and signed in. A community add-on, not an official Silo app.

extension.summary: Install and update Founders Theater for Kodi
extension.description: The Founders Theater add-on repository provides installation packages and updates for Founders Theater.

extension.summary: Founders Theater: a community Kodi add-on for Silo
extension.description: Founders Theater is a community add-on for Silo media servers, not an official Silo app. Browse your Silo library with a TV interface modeled on the Silo Android TV app, choose a media file and resume movies and episodes from your saved position.
extension.disclaimer: Founders Theater is not made or endorsed by the Silo project. Select HDR and Dolby Vision settings that your device and display support.

extension.summary: Moves Founders Theater to its new add-on
extension.description: Founders Theater now installs as its own add-on. This update helper brings it in, keeps your sign-in and settings, and passes old shortcuts and favourites on to it. Once Founders Theater opens normally, you can uninstall this helper.
extension.lifecyclestate: Founders Theater has moved to a new add-on, which this update installs. You can uninstall this helper once Founders Theater opens normally.
